scope: 48 existing six-joint fitting cases x4 conditions; five exact preflight replays. No unseen execution or training.
nominal: Frozen E120 reference/correction ensembles, bounded residual, calibrated bias and history updates in every condition.
metric: baseline/universal_readiness use original reference J.T J + .015^2 I. analytical_metric/combined use solve(gram,cross).T from identical current E120 histories only for projection metric, at every eligible phase including probes. No analytical nominal action.
readiness: universal_readiness/combined apply existing routed handoff to all cases. At close entry use existing pick_goal or original xy at z=.24; xy error<=8mm,z error<=12mm,axis error<.08,object xy drift<=8mm. Hold close-entry joint posture, keep open if not ready. At lift entry abort/hold/open unless ready and at least five consecutive final two-pad close steps. No retries or extra interactions. Routed behavior unchanged.
budget: Original caps: calibration32,approach80,descend100 or300 only if route accepted,probe32,close40,lift100,transport100,lower100,release40,retreat80,settle40. Original early exit/scoring. Release265mm, probe/gripper/link protection, planning and E120 unchanged.
analysis: Paired success/collision losses against 48/48 fitting baseline, actual interactions, readiness/abort and projection counts. Full baseline exact replay required. No selection on unseen data. Thresholds inherited without fitting retuning.
videos: Baseline and candidates for every discordant case plus fixed cases0,26,43,62,67; all available success/failure categories. Actual saved state replay.
